evidence.claim: npm run build does not produce distributable artifacts; distribution requires npm run bundle plus optional build:sandbox and build:binary.

The CLI bundle is a code-split ESM build at bundle/gemini.js with @lydell/node-pty, @github/keytar, and @google/gemini-cli-devtools externalized; devtools are built separately by the bundle script chain.
Four release channels exist (dev, nightly, preview, latest): nightly is cron-driven, promote coordinates preview and stable together, and manual/patch/rollback are separate workflows.
The PR gate requires lint, link_checker, test_linux, test_mac, test_windows, codeql, and bundle_size to each succeed or be skipped; nightly evals/perf/memory are not on the PR gate.
scripts/version.js bumps root + workspace versions and rewrites config.sandboxImageUri in lockstep with the root version, then refreshes package-lock.json.

contradictions.description: test-build-binary.yml is workflow_dispatch-only; the SEA binary path has no scheduled or PR gate.
Makefile 'build-all' delegates to npm run build:all, which omits build:binary; the name is narrower than it sounds.

risks.description: Pollux currently lives as a pure-TS module; if future Pollux code adds a native addon or dynamic require, esbuild externals and build_binary native-staging need updates and have no Pollux-aware test.
risks.suggestedGuard: Keep Pollux pure-TS; add a bundle smoke once /pollux command lands.

risks.description: Bundle-size guard uses a 1000-byte threshold over ./bundle/**/*.{js,sb}; Pollux modules could silently cross it.
risks.suggestedGuard: Document expected bundle delta in the Pollux rollout PR.

risks.description: Perf/memory/evals nightly suites are not PR-gated; a Pollux regression is only visible next morning on main.
risks.suggestedGuard: Make compartment-14 benchmark harness PR-dispatchable for Pollux rollout PRs.

risks.description: Nightly release auto-opens a PR that bumps package.json version + sandboxImageUri; overlapping version-touching PRs between 00:00 UTC and PR merge risk conflict.
risks.suggestedGuard: Avoid landing version-touching PRs during the nightly release window.

tests: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint + 3-OS × 3-node test matrix + bundle smoke + npx tarball smoke)
observabilitySignals: Auto-created release-failure,priority/p0 issues on nightly/manual/sandbox/rollback failure
Nightly release PR authored by gemini-cli-robot
